title: ArduPilot Methodic Configurator Log Analysis
description: Log Report containing vehicle context, flight timeline, log data availability results and log analysis results.

schema_version.description: Version of the log analysis report format.

flight.description: Timeline information for the analyzed flight log. Used to interpret timestamps associated with analysis findings.

start_time_us.description: Start timestamp of the analyzed log in microseconds.

end_time_us.description: End timestamp of the analyzed log in microseconds.

duration_us.description: Duration of the analyzed log in microseconds.

vehicle_components.description: Vehicle component data generated by ArduPilot Methodic Configurator.

data_availability.description: Results describing whether the log contains sufficient and valid data for analysis. Separate availability model (Battery, IMU, GPS, ...).

analysis.description: Analysis results. Only modules that were actually analyzed appear here. A failed analysis does not necessarily mean that the analysis itself failed.

step_info.description: Documentation for the related configuration step, sourced from configuration_steps_Arducopter.json. Null when no related step applies or the step wasn't found.

why_now.description: Why this step must happen at this point in the sequence.

blog_text.description: Display text for the AMC tuning guide link.

blog_url.description: URL to the relevant AMC tuning guide section.

wiki_text.description: Display text for the ArduPilot wiki link.

wiki_url.description: URL to the relevant ArduPilot wiki page.

param_info.description: Parameter metadata for param_name, sourced from apm.pdef.xml. Null when no param applies or apm_doc was unavailable.

units.description: Physical units for this parameter's value, if any.

availability_issue.description: A specific problem detected while checking log data availability. Field names match ardupilot_methodic_configurator.log_analysis.data_model_log_availability.AvailabilityIssue exactly, with step_info/param_info documentation.

message.description: Description of the data availability issue.

config_step.description: Configuration step filename related to this issue, or empty if none applies.

param_name.description: Parameter name this issue relates to, if a single parameter fix applies.

suggested_value.description: Suggested value for param_name, used to drive the Fix button in the UI.

availability_result.description: Result of a log data availability check. Field names match LogAvailabilityResult exactly. It has no configuration_steps field, only related_step.

available.description: Whether the required data is available.

state.description: State produced by the availability check (LogAvailabilityState values).

issues.description: Specific issues found during the availability check.

related_step.description: Primary configuration step filename related to this result. Empty string when no single step applies.

analysis_outcome.description: A single finding produced by an analysis. Field names match LogAnalysis exactly, plus embedded step_info/param_info documentation.

timestamp_us.description: Timestamp associated with the finding, in microseconds. Null for static or configuration only findings.

value.description: Measured or calculated value associated with the finding.

related_step.description: Configuration step filename related to this finding.

param_name.description: Parameter associated with this finding, if a single parameter fix applies.

suggested_value.description: Suggested value for param_name, used to drive the Fix button in the UI.

completed_analysis.description: Completed log analysis. Field names match LogAnalysisResult exactly. It has no configuration_steps field.

name.description: Name of the analysis (e.g. 'Battery Analysis', 'IMU Analysis').

available.description: Whether the analysis had sufficient data to produce a result.

outcomes.description: Individual findings produced by the analysis.

related_step.description: Primary configuration step filename related to this analysis. Empty string when no single step applies.

pending_analysis.description: Analysis that has not yet been performed for this subsystem.

name.description: Name of the analysis that is pending.

status.description: Analysis has not yet been performed, typically because the corresponding availability check reported available=false.

reason.description: Why this analysis is pending, taken directly from the availability check result that gated it. States a fact about missing/insufficient data - never implies misconfiguration unless the underlying availability issue explicitly says so.

issues.description: Specific availability issues that caused this analysis to be pending.

analysis_entry.description: Either a completed analysis or an analysis that has not yet been performed.
